description.value: Established in 2005, The Brewery Creek Liquor Store is Vancouver's first specialty craft beer retail store, housed in a 3,000-square-foot space in the Mt. Pleasant neighbourhood. It stocks over 500 craft beers and 500 wines alongside spirits, ciders, hard seltzers, and alcohol-free options, and has earned multiple awards including Best Beer Store from The Georgia Straight and Best Local Private Liquor Store from CAMRA. Dogs are explicitly welcomed inside, making it a friendly stop for cyclists touring the area.
